items.l1: Only when the platform, the regulators and the passengers all make joint efforts can the line of defense for travel safety truly be built up.
items.notes: Low score from synonym choice only (唯有/只有, 发力/努力); all three parties, 'truly' and the defense line are intact; faithful.

items.l1: Some people are used to rushing to treat everyone, seeing paying the bill as a way of expressing friendship; others advocate splitting the bill equally, believing that everyone paying for themselves is cleaner and more comfortable.
items.notes: Faithful; gap is lexical (付账/买单, AA制/平摊, 清爽自在/干净利落) with several valid Chinese renderings.

items.l1: The whole process requires no talking about money and no repeated polite refusals, which both preserves the dignity of the host and spares the guests any psychological burden.
items.notes: Faithful; host/guests are natural for 请客者/被请者, so back-translations drift to 客人 without any meaning loss.

items.l1: Of course, technology can only resolve awkwardness in form, and the real sense of propriety still depends on the relationship between the people involved: with a close friend of many years, there is no need to fuss over who pays a little more; with someone you have just met, clear accounts are instead a form of respect.
items.notes: Long sentence with lexical spread; changed 'it is not worth worrying about' to 'there is no need to fuss over' to match 不必计较 (no need, not 'not worth').

items.l1: Caring for a patient is not merely keeping watch; it is more like a long test of endurance: the folding bed is too narrow, the coughing at night is too frequent, and during the day I also have to deal with work and bills.
items.notes: Faithful; first-person 'I' is implied by the narrator context; gap is wording (陪护病人/陪护, 守着/守候).

items.l1: Through the sense of ritual in every stitch, they reconfirm where they come from.
items.notes: Faithful; blind back-translation matches gold in meaning (通过/借由, 从哪里来/从何而来 are register variants).

items.l1: In recent years, a fitness craze has taken off among urban white-collar workers.
items.notes: 'Swept through' intensified 掀起 into 席卷; changed to 'has taken off among' to match 'a craze arose among' white-collar workers.

items.l1: Last autumn, I began renovating the old apartment I had lived in for twenty years.
items.notes: Faithful ('old apartment' = 旧公寓, twenty years kept); gap is wording only.

items.l1: But things were far trickier than I had imagined.
items.notes: Generic 'difficult' steered back-translation to 难; changed to 'trickier' to carry 棘手 (hard to handle).

items.l1: For a while I felt wronged, thinking that renovation simply could not be done without noise.
items.notes: Faithful; 'could not be done without noise' is equivalent to 无法避免噪音 and 'simply' carries 本就; low score is from wording.

items.l1: The spend-and-save rules are then repeatedly broken down into formulas that are easy to calculate in one's head, such as "50 off for every 300 spent", and once the amount is reached, not buying instead feels like a loss.
items.notes: Faithful; 300/50 match 三百/五十; 'then' fits 则 after the 先 in the previous sentence; gap is lexical (心算/口算, 吃亏/损失).

items.l1: She finally gave a bad review, describing the whole course of the negotiation in the review.
items.notes: 'In detail' added 详细 on top of 完整; removed it so 'the whole course' alone carries 完整描述.

items.l1: Second, one should note whether the definitions are consistent.
items.notes: Faithful; blind back-translation is nearly identical to gold (注意/留意).

items.l1: For example, even for the same "unemployment rate," some count only registered unemployed people, while others also include people who have voluntarily given up looking for work; with different definitions, the results naturally differ greatly, and if the two are compared directly, one will inevitably reach a misleading judgment.
items.notes: Faithful; long sentence with many synonym choices (涵盖/算进去, 悬殊/相差很大); every claim is present.

items.l1: Third is sample size and sampling method.
items.notes: Faithful; 再次 in this list means 'third', so 第三 vs 再次 is a valid alternative rendering.

items.l1: Only by considering these aspects together and weighing them again and again will one avoid being led along by pretty numbers.
items.notes: The reference dropped 综合 (taken together) and added 'by the nose' (牵着鼻子走 vs gold 牵着走); restored 'together' and used 'led along'.

items.l1: The morning is almost entirely spent on this step, but she knows well that if the foundation is not solid, even the most beautiful charts are nothing but castles in the air.
items.notes: Faithful; gap is wording (基础/地基, 漂亮/精美, 花/耗) and the idiom 空中楼阁 is kept.

items.l1: This change is not always easy.
items.notes: Faithful; 并不总是容易 vs 并非总是轻松 differ only in wording.

items.l1: When parents raise several children, it is inevitable that, because their energy is limited, they give some more attention than others, and the older child often feels a certain degree of "favouritism", with disappointment and grievance welling up in the heart.
items.notes: 'They favour some' made the parents guilty of favouritism, but gold says they neutrally 有所侧重 and the child perceives 偏心; changed it to 'give some more attention'.

items.l1: After getting out, the drivers first checked whether anyone was injured, and then used their phones to photograph the positions of the vehicles, the points of impact and the road markings.
items.notes: Faithful; every item and the order are intact; gap is wording (拍下/拍摄, 然后/再).

items.l1: In fact, any call from a stranger that demands secrecy, urges a transfer, or asks for a verification code is almost without exception a trap.
items.notes: Faithful; 陷阱 vs 圈套 and 索要 vs 索取 are synonyms.

items.l1: As the end of the year approaches, the atmosphere inside the company quietly changes.
items.notes: Faithful; 年底 vs 岁末 is only a register-level synonym that English cannot mark.

items.l1: The venue has been set up to be brightly lit, and the long tables are covered with fruit and drinks.
items.notes: 'Brilliantly with lights' and 'piled with' pointed to 灯火辉煌/堆满; changed to 'set up to be brightly lit' (布置得灯火通明) and 'covered with' (摆满).
